subject: English
question: Choose the correct completion: Aman and Ravi jointly own one workshop. ___ workshop is near the bus stand.
explanation: For joint possession, the possessive ending is normally attached only to the final name. Aman's and Ravi's would ordinarily indicate separate possession.
explanation_pa: ਸਾਂਝੀ ਮਾਲਕੀ ਦੱਸਣ ਲਈ possessive ending ਆਮ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਆਖ਼ਰੀ ਨਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਲੱਗਦੀ ਹੈ। 'Aman's and Ravi's' ਆਮ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਦੋਵਾਂ ਦੀ ਵੱਖੋ-ਵੱਖਰੀ ਮਾਲਕੀ ਦੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct replacement for the bracketed words: The revised policy introduces [a stricter criteria] for promotion.
explanation: Criterion is singular and criteria is plural. The article a therefore requires criterion.
explanation_pa: 'Criterion' singular ਹੈ ਅਤੇ 'criteria' plural ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਲਈ article 'a' ਨਾਲ 'criterion' ਆਵੇਗਾ।

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence: Please keep this information between you and ___.
explanation: A preposition takes an objective pronoun, so between requires me. I is a subject form.
explanation_pa: preposition ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ objective pronoun ਆਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ 'between' ਨਾਲ 'me' ਆਵੇਗਾ। 'I' subject ਵਾਲਾ ਰੂਪ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: In 'The principal herself checked the sealed packets', how is 'herself' used?
explanation: Herself emphasises that the principal personally performed the action. It is not a reflexive object because checked already has the object packets.
explanation_pa: 'Herself' ਇਸ ਗੱਲ 'ਤੇ ਜ਼ੋਰ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਪ੍ਰਿੰਸੀਪਲ ਨੇ ਆਪ ਇਹ ਕੰਮ ਕੀਤਾ। ਇਹ reflexive object ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ, ਕਿਉਂਕਿ 'checked' ਦਾ object ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਹੀ 'packets' ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence in formal written English: The consultant to ___ the department referred the dispute has replied.
explanation: Whom is the objective relative pronoun required after the preposition to. Who is not used directly after a preposition in this formal construction.
explanation_pa: preposition 'to' ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ objective relative pronoun 'whom' ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ। ਇਸ formal ਬਣਤਰ ਵਿੱਚ preposition ਦੇ ਤੁਰੰਤ ਬਾਅਦ 'who' ਨਹੀਂ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ।

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence: If one accepts a public responsibility, one must fulfil ___ obligations.
explanation: The possessive form of the indefinite pronoun one is one's. Ones' is not the possessive form required here.
explanation_pa: indefinite pronoun 'one' ਦਾ possessive ਰੂਪ 'one's' ਹੈ। ਇੱਥੇ ਲੋੜੀਂਦਾ possessive ਰੂਪ 'ones'' ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct replacement for 'many useful advices': The mentor gave us many useful advices.
explanation: Advice is uncountable; individual recommendations are pieces of advice. Many cannot directly modify advice.
explanation_pa: 'Advice' uncountable ਹੈ; ਵੱਖ-ਵੱਖ ਸਲਾਹਾਂ ਲਈ 'pieces of advice' ਵਰਤਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। 'Many' ਸਿੱਧਾ 'advice' ਨਾਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਲੱਗ ਸਕਦਾ।

subject: English
question: Under the traditional formal rule requiring a subject pronoun after the linking verb 'be', complete: It was ___ who first reported the discrepancy.
explanation: Traditional formal grammar uses the subjective form I as the complement of be. Me is common in everyday usage but does not satisfy the expressly stated rule.
explanation_pa: ਰਵਾਇਤੀ formal grammar ਵਿੱਚ 'be' ਦੇ complement ਵਜੋਂ subjective ਰੂਪ 'I' ਵਰਤਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਰੋਜ਼ਾਨਾ ਬੋਲਚਾਲ ਵਿੱਚ 'me' ਆਮ ਹੈ, ਪਰ ਇਹ ਸਪਸ਼ਟ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਦਿੱਤੇ ਨਿਯਮ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਠੀਕ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence: The farmer counted twelve ___ near the canal.
explanation: Sheep has the same singular and plural form. Sheeps is not its standard plural.
explanation_pa: 'Sheep' ਦਾ singular ਅਤੇ plural ਰੂਪ ਇੱਕੋ ਜਿਹਾ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ। 'Sheeps' ਇਸ ਦਾ ਮਿਆਰੀ plural ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence: Each of the two machines has ___ own serial number.
explanation: Each treats every machine individually, so the singular inanimate possessive its is required. It's means it is or it has and cannot express possession.
explanation_pa: 'Each' ਹਰ ਮਸ਼ੀਨ ਨੂੰ ਵੱਖਰੇ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਲੈਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ ਬੇਜਾਨ ਚੀਜ਼ ਲਈ singular possessive 'its' ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ। 'It's' ਦਾ ਅਰਥ 'it is' ਜਾਂ 'it has' ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਇਹ ਮਾਲਕੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਦੱਸ ਸਕਦਾ।

subject: English
question: The noun 'jury' in 'The jury delivered its verdict' is a:
explanation: Jury names a group of people considered as a unit and is therefore collective. An abstract noun names a quality, state or idea.
explanation_pa: 'Jury' ਲੋਕਾਂ ਦੇ ਅਜਿਹੇ ਸਮੂਹ ਦਾ ਨਾਂ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਇੱਕ ਇਕਾਈ ਵਜੋਂ ਲਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ ਇਹ collective noun ਹੈ। abstract noun ਕਿਸੇ ਗੁਣ, ਅਵਸਥਾ ਜਾਂ ਵਿਚਾਰ ਦਾ ਨਾਂ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence: Let ___ present the joint proposal.
explanation: Let takes objective pronouns, so both coordinated pronouns must be him and me. Him and I mixes objective and subjective case.
explanation_pa: 'Let' ਨਾਲ objective pronouns ਆਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ, ਇਸ ਲਈ ਜੋੜੇ ਗਏ ਦੋਵੇਂ pronouns 'him' ਅਤੇ 'me' ਹੋਣੇ ਚਾਹੀਦੇ ਹਨ। 'Him and I' ਵਿੱਚ objective ਅਤੇ subjective case ਰਲ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ।

subject: English
question: Choose the sentence that correctly means 'She trusts me more than she trusts him.'
options: She trusts me more than he does.
She trusts I more than him.
She trusts me more than him.
She trusts myself more than he.
explanation: Him is the object of the understood verb trusts in the comparison. He does makes the comparison between two people doing the trusting and changes the meaning.
explanation_pa: ਇਸ ਤੁਲਨਾ ਵਿੱਚ 'him' ਉਸ verb 'trusts' ਦਾ object ਹੈ ਜੋ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ ਗਿਆ ਪਰ ਸਮਝਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। 'He does' ਵਰਤਣ ਨਾਲ ਤੁਲਨਾ ਭਰੋਸਾ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਦੋ ਵਿਅਕਤੀਆਂ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਅਰਥ ਬਦਲ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence: I interviewed two applicants, but neither of ___ had the required certificate.
explanation: Of is a preposition and requires the objective form them. They cannot serve as the object of of.
explanation_pa: 'Of' ਇੱਕ preposition ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ objective ਰੂਪ 'them' ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ। 'They', 'of' ਦਾ object ਨਹੀਂ ਬਣ ਸਕਦਾ।

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence: The officer ___ everyone believed would lead the inquiry declined the assignment.
explanation: Who is the subject of would lead within the embedded clause. The intervening words everyone believed do not make it an object requiring whom.
explanation_pa: ਅੰਦਰਲੇ clause ਵਿੱਚ 'who', 'would lead' ਦਾ subject ਹੈ। ਵਿਚਕਾਰ ਆਏ ਸ਼ਬਦ 'everyone believed' ਇਸ ਨੂੰ object ਨਹੀਂ ਬਣਾਉਂਦੇ ਕਿ ਇੱਥੇ 'whom' ਦੀ ਲੋੜ ਪਵੇ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct completion: The hostel has a separate reading room for women; it is the ___ reading room.
explanation: An irregular plural that does not end in s forms its possessive with apostrophe-s. Womens' incorrectly treats women as a plural ending in s.
explanation_pa: ਜਿਹੜਾ irregular plural 's' ਨਾਲ ਖ਼ਤਮ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦਾ, ਉਸ ਦਾ possessive ਬਣਾਉਣ ਲਈ apostrophe-s ਲਾਇਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। 'Womens'' ਗ਼ਲਤ ਹੈ, ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਇਸ ਵਿੱਚ 'women' ਨੂੰ 's' ਨਾਲ ਖ਼ਤਮ ਹੋਣ ਵਾਲਾ plural ਮੰਨਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence: The two wrestlers congratulated ___ after their bout.
explanation: Each other expresses a reciprocal action between the two wrestlers. Each other's is possessive and requires a following noun.
explanation_pa: 'Each other' ਦੋ ਪਹਿਲਵਾਨਾਂ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਇੱਕ-ਦੂਜੇ ਨਾਲ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾਣ ਵਾਲੀ reciprocal action ਦੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ। 'Each other's' possessive ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ noun ਆਉਣਾ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence: The candidate ___ admit card was damaged received a duplicate.
explanation: Whose expresses possession before a noun. Whom cannot show that the admit card belongs to the candidate.
explanation_pa: 'Whose' noun ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਆ ਕੇ ਮਾਲਕੀ ਦੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ। 'Whom' ਇਹ ਨਹੀਂ ਦੱਸ ਸਕਦਾ ਕਿ ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ ਕਾਰਡ ਉਮੀਦਵਾਰ ਦਾ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct plural: Both of their ___ attended the ceremony.
explanation: In mother-in-law, the principal noun mother takes the plural ending. Adding s only to law pluralises the wrong element.
explanation_pa: 'Mother-in-law' ਵਿੱਚ ਮੁੱਖ noun 'mother' ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ plural ending ਇਸੇ ਨਾਲ ਲੱਗਦੀ ਹੈ। ਸਿਰਫ਼ 'law' ਨਾਲ 's' ਜੋੜਨ ਨਾਲ ਗ਼ਲਤ ਹਿੱਸੇ ਦਾ plural ਬਣ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct completion using the double possessive: This portrait belongs to a friend ___.
explanation: The double possessive combines of with a possessive form: a friend of my father's. Of my father is a different construction and does not meet the stated requirement.
explanation_pa: double possessive ਵਿੱਚ 'of' ਨਾਲ possessive ਰੂਪ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜਿਵੇਂ 'a friend of my father's'। 'Of my father' ਇੱਕ ਵੱਖਰੀ ਬਣਤਰ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਗਈ ਸ਼ਰਤ ਪੂਰੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰਦੀ।

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence: The charity supplied winter clothing to several ___.
explanation: The plural of passer-by is passers-by because passer is the principal noun. Passer-bys incorrectly adds the plural ending to the adverb.
explanation_pa: 'Passer-by' ਦਾ plural 'passers-by' ਹੈ, ਕਿਉਂਕਿ 'passer' ਮੁੱਖ noun ਹੈ। 'Passer-bys' ਵਿੱਚ ਗ਼ਲਤੀ ਨਾਲ adverb ਨਾਲ plural ending ਜੋੜੀ ਗਈ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Choose the feminine counterpart of 'nephew' to complete the sentence: Harjit introduced his brother's daughter as his ___.
explanation: A brother's or sister's daughter is a niece, the feminine counterpart of nephew. A cousin belongs to a different family relationship.
explanation_pa: ਭਰਾ ਜਾਂ ਭੈਣ ਦੀ ਧੀ ਨੂੰ 'niece' ਕਹਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਜੋ 'nephew' ਦਾ feminine ਰੂਪ ਹੈ। 'Cousin' ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਦੇ ਇੱਕ ਵੱਖਰੇ ਰਿਸ਼ਤੇ ਲਈ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence: The athlete blamed ___ for missing the final practice session.
explanation: A reflexive pronoun is required when the subject and object refer to the same person. Him normally indicates another male person here.
explanation_pa: ਜਦੋਂ subject ਅਤੇ object ਇੱਕੋ ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਲਈ ਵਰਤੇ ਜਾਣ, ਤਾਂ reflexive pronoun ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ। ਇੱਥੇ 'him' ਆਮ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਕਿਸੇ ਹੋਰ ਮਰਦ ਵੱਲ ਇਸ਼ਾਰਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Choose the grammatically correct sentence.
options: The office needs several new furnitures.
The office needs several new piece of furniture.
The office needs several new furniture.
The office needs several new pieces of furniture.
explanation: Furniture is uncountable and is counted through expressions such as pieces of furniture. Furnitures is not the standard plural for ordinary office items.
explanation_pa: 'Furniture' uncountable ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਇਸ ਨੂੰ ਗਿਣਨ ਲਈ 'pieces of furniture' ਵਰਗੇ ਸ਼ਬਦ-ਸਮੂਹ ਵਰਤੇ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ। ਦਫ਼ਤਰ ਦੀਆਂ ਆਮ ਚੀਜ਼ਾਂ ਲਈ 'furnitures' ਮਿਆਰੀ plural ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence: The research team recorded three unusual atmospheric ___.
explanation: The standard plural of phenomenon is phenomena. Phenomenon is singular and cannot follow three.
explanation_pa: 'Phenomenon' ਦਾ ਮਿਆਰੀ plural 'phenomena' ਹੈ। 'Phenomenon' singular ਹੈ ਅਤੇ 'three' ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਨਹੀਂ ਆ ਸਕਦਾ।
